shloka_text: रामो बहून्यहान्येवं तद्गीतं परमं शुभम् । शुश्राव मुनिभिः सार्धं पार्थिवैः सह वानरैः ।। 7.95.1 ।।
transliteration: rāmo bahūnyahānyevaṃ tadgītaṃ paramaṃ śubham | śuśrāva munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ pārthivaiḥ saha vānaraiḥ || 7.95.1 ||
translation: रामो Rama, बहूनि many, अहानि days, एवम् thus, तत् that, गीतम् song, परमम् supreme, शुभम् auspicious, शुश्राव heard, मुनिभिः with sages, सार्धम् together, पार्थिवैः with kings, सह along with, वानरैः monkeys.
explanation: Rama thus heard that supremely auspicious song for many days, accompanied by sages, kings, and monkeys.
comments: Hearing the song day by day and recognizing Kusha and Lava as Sita's sons, Rama sends to Valmiki to ask that Sita, if pure, take an oath of purification before the assembly on the morrow -- Valmiki assents, and Rama announces it to the sages and kings, who applaud, before the gathering disperses for the morrow.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्गीते तु विज्ञाय सीतापुत्रौ कुशीलवौ । तस्याः परिषदो मध्ये रामो वचनमब्रवीत् । दूताञ्छुद्धसमाचारानाहूयात्ममनीषया ।। 7.95.2 ।।
transliteration: tasmingīte tu vijñāya sītāputrau kuśīlavau | tasyāḥ pariṣado madhye rāmo vacanamabravīt | dūtāñchuddhasamācārānāhūyātmamanīṣayā || 7.95.2 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that, गीते song, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having recognized, सीतापुत्रौ the sons of Sita, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, तस्याः of that, परिषदः assembly, मध्ये in the midst, रामो Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, दूतान् messengers, शुद्धसमाचारान् of pure conduct, आहूय having called, आत्ममनीषया by his own intention.
explanation: Having recognized Kusha and Lava as Sita's sons through that song, Rama, by his own intention, called messengers of pure conduct and spoke words in the midst of that assembly.

translation: मद्वचो my words, ब्रूत speak, गच्छध्वम् go, इतः from here, भगवतः of the revered one, अन्तिकम् to the presence.
explanation: He instructed them, "Go from here to the presence of the revered one (Valmiki) and speak my words."

shloka_text: परिषदो मध्ये रामो वचनमब्रवीत् । यदि शुद्धसमाचारा यदि वा वीतकल्मषा । करोत्विहात्मनः शुद्धिमनुमान्य महामुनिम् ।। 7.95.4 ।।
transliteration: pariṣado madhye rāmo vacanamabravīt | yadi śuddhasamācārā yadi vā vītakalmaṣā | karotvihātmanaḥ śuddhimanumānya mahāmunim || 7.95.4 ||
translation: परिषदो of the assembly, मध्ये in the midst, रामः Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, यदि if, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, यदि if, वा or, वीतकल्मषा free from sin, करोतु let her perform, इह here, आत्मनः of herself, शुद्धिम् purification, अनुमान्य having obtained permission from, महामुनिम् the great sage.
explanation: In the midst of the assembly, Rama spoke, saying that if Sita is of pure conduct or free from sin, she should perform her purification here, having obtained the great sage's permission.

shloka_text: छन्दं मुनेश्च विज्ञाय सीतायाश्च मनोगतम् । प्रत्ययं दातुकामायास्ततः शंसत मे लघु ।। 7.95.5 ।।
transliteration: chandaṃ muneśca vijñāya sītāyāśca manogatam | pratyayaṃ dātukāmāyāstataḥ śaṃsata me laghu || 7.95.5 ||
translation: छन्दम् the wish, मुनेः of the sage, च and, विज्ञाय having known, सीतायाः of Sita, च and, मनोगतम् the thought in her mind, प्रत्ययम् proof, दातुकामायाः who wishes to give, ततः then, शंसत tell, मे to me, लघु quickly.
explanation: Having understood the wish of the sage and the thought in Sita's mind, who desires to give proof, then quickly report it to me.

shloka_text: श्वः प्रभाते तु शपथं मैथिली जनकात्मजा । करोतु परिषन्मध्ये शोधनार्थं ममैव च ।। 7.95.6 ।।
transliteration: śvaḥ prabhāte tu śapathaṃ maithilī janakātmajā | karotu pariṣanmadhye śodhanārthaṃ mamaiva ca || 7.95.6 ||
translation: श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते in the morning, तु indeed, शपथम् an oath, मैथिली Maithili, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, करोतु let her perform, परिषन्मध्ये in the midst of the assembly, शोधनार्थम् for the sake of purification, मम my, एव indeed, च and.
explanation: Let Maithili, Janaka's daughter, perform an oath tomorrow morning in the midst of the assembly for her own purification and indeed for mine.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु ऱागवस्यैतद्वचः परममद्भुतम् । दूताः सम्प्रययुर्बाटं यत्रास्ते मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। 7.95.7 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu ऱ्āgavasyaitadvacaḥ paramamadbhutam | dūtāḥ samprayayurbāṭaṃ yatrāste munipuṅgavaḥ || 7.95.7 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, राघवस्य of Rama, एतत् this, वचः word, परमम् most, अद्भुतम् wonderful, दूताः messengers, सम्प्रययुः went forth, बाटम् to the hermitage, यत्र where, आस्ते resides, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages.
explanation: Having heard this most wonderful speech of Rama, the messengers went forth to the hermitage where the foremost among sages, Valmiki, resided.

shloka_text: ते प्रणम्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तममितप्रभम् । ऊचुस्ते रामवाक्यानि मृदूनि मधुराणि च ।। 7.95.8 ।।
transliteration: te praṇamya mahātmānaṃ jvalantamamitaprabham | ūcuste rāmavākyāni mṛdūni madhurāṇi ca || 7.95.8 ||
translation: ते they, प्रणम्य having bowed down to, महात्मानम् the great soul, ज्वलन्तम् shining, अमितप्रभम् of immeasurable splendor, ऊचुः they spoke, ते those, रामवाक्यानि Rama's words, मृदूनि soft, मधुराणि sweet, च and.
explanation: Having bowed down to the great soul, who was shining with immeasurable splendor, they spoke Rama's words, which were both soft and sweet.

shloka_text: तेषां तद्व्याहृतं श्रुत्वा रामस्य च मनोगतम् । विज्ञाय सुमहातेजा मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.95.9 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvyāhṛtaṃ śrutvā rāmasya ca manogatam | vijñāya sumahātejā munirvākyamathābravīt || 7.95.9 ||
translation: तेषां their, तद्व्याहृतं their words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्य of Rama, च and, मनोगतम् his intention, विज्ञाय having understood, सुमहातेजा the greatly effulgent, मुनिः sage, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard their words and understood Rama's intention, the greatly effulgent sage Valmiki then spoke.

shloka_text: एवं भवतु भद्रं वो यथा वदति राघवः । तथा करिष्यते सीता दैवतं हि पतिः स्त्रियाः ।। 7.95.10 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ vo yathā vadati rāghavaḥ | tathā kariṣyate sītā daivataṃ hi patiḥ striyāḥ || 7.95.10 ||
translation: एवं thus, भवतु let it be, भद्रं good fortune, वः to you, यथा as, वदति speaks, राघवः Rama, तथा so, करिष्यते will do, सीता Sita, दैवतं deity, हि indeed, पतिः husband, स्त्रियाः of a woman.
explanation: Let it be so, good fortune to you, as Rama speaks, so will Sita do, for indeed, a husband is the deity of a woman.

shloka_text: तथोक्ता मुनिना सर्वे राजदूता महौजसम् । प्रत्येत्य राघवं क्षिप्रं मुनिवाक्यं बभाषिरे ।। 7.95.11 ।।
transliteration: tathoktā muninā sarve rājadūtā mahaujasam | pratyetya rāghavaṃ kṣipraṃ munivākyaṃ babhāṣire || 7.95.11 ||
translation: तथा thus, उक्ताः spoken to, मुनिना by the sage, सर्वे all, राजदूताः royal messengers, प्रत्येत्य having returned, राघवं to Rama, क्षिप्रं quickly, मुनिवाक्यं the sage's words, बभाषिरे spoke, महौजसम् to the greatly powerful one.
explanation: All the royal messengers, thus addressed by the sage, quickly returned to the greatly powerful Rama and conveyed the sage's words.

shloka_text: ततः प्रहृष्टः काकुत्स्थः श्रुत्वा वाक्यं महात्मनः । ऋषींस्तत्र समेतांश्च राज्ञश्चैवाभ्यभाषत ।। 7.95.12 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ kākutsthaḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ mahātmanaḥ | ṛṣīṃstatra sametāṃśca rājñaścaivābhyabhāṣata || 7.95.12 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रहृष्टः delighted, काकुत्स्थः Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, वाक्यं the words, महात्मनः of the great soul, ऋषीन् to the sages, तत्र there, समेतान् assembled, च and, राज्ञः to the kings, च and, एव indeed, अभ्यभाषत addressed.
explanation: Then, greatly delighted after hearing the words of the great soul Valmiki, Rama addressed the sages and kings assembled there.

shloka_text: भगवन्तः सशिष्या वै सानुगाश्च नराधिपाः । पश्यन्तु सीताशपथं यश्चैवान्यो ऽपि काङ्क्षते ।। 7.95.13 ।।
transliteration: bhagavantaḥ saśiṣyā vai sānugāśca narādhipāḥ | paśyantu sītāśapathaṃ yaścaivānyo 'pi kāṅkṣate || 7.95.13 ||
translation: भगवन्तः O revered ones, सशिष्याः with disciples, वै indeed, सानुगाः with followers, च and, नराधिपाः O kings, पश्यन्तु let them see, सीताशपथं Sita's oath, यः who, च and, एव indeed, अन्यः other, अपि also, काङ्क्षते desires.
explanation: O revered sages with your disciples, and O kings with your followers, let all who desire witness Sita's oath.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्य महात्मनः । सर्वेषामृषिमुख्यानां साधुवादो महानभूत् ।। 7.95.14 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ | sarveṣāmṛṣimukhyānāṃ sādhuvādo mahānabhūt || 7.95.14 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवस्य of Rama, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, सर्वेषाम् of all, ऋषिमुख्यानां of the chief sages, साधुवादो applause, महान् great, अभूत् was.
explanation: Having heard the words of the great-souled Rama, a great acclamation arose from all the chief sages.

shloka_text: राजानश्च महात्मानः प्रशंसन्ति स्म राघवम् । उपपन्नं नरश्रेष्ठ त्वय्येव भुवि नान्यतः ।। 7.95.15 ।।
transliteration: rājānaśca mahātmānaḥ praśaṃsanti sma rāghavam | upapannaṃ naraśreṣṭha tvayyeva bhuvi nānyataḥ || 7.95.15 ||
translation: राजानश्च and kings, महात्मानः great-souled ones, प्रशंसन्ति स्म praised, राघवम् Rama, उपपन्नं fitting, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, त्वय्येव in you alone, भुवि on earth, नान्यतः not elsewhere.
explanation: The great-souled kings also praised Rama, saying, "O best among men, this is fitting only in you on earth, and not in anyone else."

shloka_text: एवं विनिश्चयं कृत्वा श्वोभूत इति राघवः । विसर्जयामास तदा सर्वांस्ताञ्छत्रुसूदनः ।। 7.95.16 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ viniścayaṃ kṛtvā śvobhūta iti rāghavaḥ | visarjayāmāsa tadā sarvāṃstāñchatrusūdanaḥ || 7.95.16 ||
translation: एवं thus, विनिश्चयं decision, कृत्वा having made, श्वोभूत tomorrow, इति thus, राघवः Rama, विसर्जयामास dismissed, तदा then, सर्वान् all, तान् them, शत्रुसूदनः the destroyer of enemies.
explanation: Having thus made the decision for "tomorrow," Rama, the destroyer of enemies, then dismissed all of them.

shloka_text: इति सम्प्रविचार्य राजसिंहः श्वोभूते शपथस्य निश्चयं वै । विससर्ज मुनीन्नृपांश्च सर्वान्स महात्मा महतो महानुभावः ।। 7.95.17 ।।
transliteration: iti sampravicārya rājasiṃhaḥ śvobhūte śapathasya niścayaṃ vai | visasarja munīnnṛpāṃśca sarvānsa mahātmā mahato mahānubhāvaḥ || 7.95.17 ||
translation: इति thus, सम्प्रविचार्य having deliberated well, राजसिंहः the lion among kings, श्वोभूते on the morrow, शपथस्य of the oath, निश्चयं decision, वै indeed, विससर्ज dismissed, मुनीन् the sages, नृपांश्च and the kings, सर्वान् all, स he, महात्मा the great-souled one, महतो great, महानुभावः of great power.
explanation: Having thus deliberated well and made the decision for the oath on the morrow, that great-souled king, the lion among kings and one of great power, dismissed all the sages and kings. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चनवतितमः सर्ग ।। 95 ।। Thus ends the ninety-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
